notes: Evidence is the pixel-gate scenes: worldfx_flat (dropped flat items, pixel-exact per the budget note), gui_* and blockicons_* for the GUI icon paths, hand_* for the held-item 2D path. The four anonymous Callable classes inside renderItemAndEffectIntoGUI are crash-report labels only. lane/hudscreens: the GUI block icon's glRotatef(210, X) uses sin 210 = -0.5 (the icon had been drawn mirrored through its rotated z, lit as if turned away: blockicons_hotbar_a 2781 to 222 px), and a tinted block lights the tint before the clamp. lane/entrender: a stacked block item's copies keep their translate outside renderBlockAsItem's 90-degree turn (raster_entities.c world_item_draw; blockicons_drops 587 to 328 px); the frame row's own items when it has the entity list. lane/idxclient: closed with the GUI glint on enchanted stacks. lane/idxclient (later): a chest's icon (and a held chest) draws with TileEntityRendererChestHelper's own sheet; a scene that recorded none takes the jar's entity/chest textures (csrc/assets/te), where the block atlas had been sampled (idx-heldblock-s1 33 from 1,826 px to 12).
